envelope.description: Catch a failing read where requests and jobs are served, and probe on the periodic check

body.title: Catch a failing read where requests and jobs are served, and probe on the periodic check
body.summary: At the three catch sites of the request server and at the queue's job runner, read the error's code before it is reduced to a message, record locks-lost for -30775 and answer with the named error. Make the daemon's periodic reader check also do the probe read and record a failure.
acceptanceChecks: A handler that throws an error with code -30775 leaves the record locks-lost and the caller receives the named error, at each of the three server sites and in the queue runner
With the locks removed and no request or write made, the periodic check records locks-lost at its next run (interval shortened for the test)

tests.name: dispatcher: a handler throwing code -30775 records locks-lost and the caller gets the named error, at each of the three server sites and the queue runner
detection through the real wrappers: a read through the dispatcher records at once
periodic check records locks-lost when no request or write has met the failure
